faqs.q: Sec. 70-148. - Medical and mental health exams (fit for duty exams).
faqs.a:
At any time for reasonable cause, the city may require an employee to undergo a medical
               and/or mental health examination by a qualified designated professional to determine
               that the employee is able to perform the essential functions of the job. Such exams
               will be conducted in accordance with a policy authorized by the city manager.
(
Ord. No. 4862
, § 1, 10-16-2023)
